schema.title: Practice setup
schema.description: The Practice Manager Agent can't read or act for a practice until this is saved. Sensible defaults are applied for anything not asked here (tone, email tiers, never-do list) — those can be refined by editing the practice's settings file directly later.

questions.label: Cliniko business ID
questions.helpText: Ask the agent to "list the Cliniko businesses" if you don't have this to hand.

questions.label: Which email platform does this practice use?
Xero organisation name (exactly as it appears in Xero)
questions.helpText: Leave blank if this practice doesn't use Xero yet.

questions.label: Time zone (IANA, e.g. Australia/Sydney or Asia/Kuala_Lumpur)
questions.helpText: The automations run on this practice's local time: inbox and diary checks from 7 AM, the morning brief at 7:30 and so on. Leave blank for Australia/Sydney.

questions.label: Cancellation window in hours, before a reschedule stops being auto-offered
Who reviews and approves drafts and diary changes for this practice?
WorkQ group for reviews (optional)
questions.helpText: Review items go to this group if the reviewer above is no longer a workspace user. Type the group's name exactly as it appears in WorkQ.

questions.label: New-patient appointment type (exact name as it appears in Cliniko)
questions.helpText: Used to propose and book new-patient enquiries at the right appointment type. There's no reliable way to guess this automatically — appointment type names vary by practice. Leave blank if you're not using the New Enquiry automation yet.

questions.label: Intake form template ID in Cliniko
questions.helpText: The patient-form template Cliniko sends new patients before their first visit. There's no tool to look this up automatically — find it in Cliniko's own form template settings and paste the ID here. Leave blank if you're not using the New Enquiry automation yet.
